programs.desc: Jared breaks free from his old partner and gets a do-or-die shot to buy a timber claim; with only ten days left to raise $200K in timber profits, his crew battles monster cedars as a raging fire threatens lives.

programs.title: The Last Woodsmen
programs.desc: Facing the devastation of losing the "Forever Claim", Jared makes a desperate deal with the powerful businessman who outbid him, but new challenges could destroy his logging season before it begins.

programs.title: The Last Woodsmen

programs.title: The Last Woodsmen
